# Data pre-processing

```{r}
#| output: false

# setup R library's and working directories
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

# Define variables pointing to the relevant directories
dataDir <- "data"
outDir <- "output"
figDir <- "figures"
```

```{r}
# Read csv and store it in the data variable. Ensure separator is ; and not ,
data <- read.csv(here::here(dataDir, "ESS11e04_2.csv"), sep = ";")

```
